title: DRINKING WATER TREATMENT PROCESSES
description: Characterization and treatment of drinking water sources including engineering principles for the selection and design of treatment processes.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: ENVE 322.
A minimum grade of C is required in ENVE 322.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
